title: Validating Autoformalized Specifications via Contrapuntal Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.30059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal specifications can make AI-generated code mechanically checkable. Because user intent is typically expressed in natural language rather than formal logic, specifications must first be derived from it, e.g., via LLM-based autoformalization. Yet autoformalized specifications are themselves untrusted, so a key challenge is validating whether they capture user intent without relying on a costly oracle such as human review. In this oracle-free setting, a natural strategy is to vote among model outputs, but because model errors are often correlated, agreement among outputs may reflect shared mistakes rather than correctness. Our key insight is that these errors can be decorrelated through representational diversity. We achieve this diversity with contrapuntal languages: pairs of task-specific formal languages, each designed to express the intended specification, yet admitting no structure-preserving translation between them. translated_title: 基于对位语言验证自动形式化规范
translated_abstract: 形式化规范可以使AI生成的代码具备可机械验证性。由于用户意图通常以自然语言而非形式逻辑表达，因此必须首先从自然语言中推导出规范，例如通过基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动形式化。然而，自动形式化得到的规范本身并不可信，因此一个关键挑战是：在不依赖昂贵“神谕”（如人工审查）的前提下，验证这些规范是否准确捕捉了用户意图。在这种无需神谕的场景下，一种自然的策略是对多个模型输出进行投票，但由于模型错误往往是相互关联的，输出之间的一致可能反映的是共同的错误而非正确性。我们的关键洞察是：这些错误可以通过表示多样性来消除相关性。我们通过对位语言来实现这种多样性：对位语言是成对的任务特定形式语言，每种语言都被设计为能够表达目标规范，但两者之间不存在保持结构的翻译。LLM会将……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出“对位语言”方法——使用一对彼此不存在保持结构翻译的任务特定形式语言来引入表示多样性，从而消除模型错误之间的相关性，使得多个LLM输出之间的一致性能够有效验证自动形式化规范是否忠实于用户意图，而无需人工审查等昂贵神谕。
en_tdlr: Proposes "contrapuntal languages" — pairs of task-specific formal languages admitting no structure-preserving translation between them — to decorrelate model errors, so that agreement among multiple LLM outputs can effectively validate whether autoformalized specifications capture user intent without costly oracles such as human review.
